summary: Packed two-lane bilinear interpolation helper using 3DNow! MMX intrinsics. Treats the four __m64 operands as pairs of single-precision floats and computes a1 = a2 + (a3 - a2) * a5 + (a4 - a2) * a6, with the two interpolation weights a5/a6 duplicated into both 32-bit lanes. Returns the output pointer a1. The clustering prelabel named FloatClamp as a structural twin, but the raw source shows interpolation, not clamping.

operations.description: Convert the 32-bit weight a5 into an MMX register with _mm_cvtsi32_si64(a5).
Convert the 32-bit weight a6 into an MMX register with _mm_cvtsi32_si64(a6).
Save the output pointer: result = a1.
Duplicate the low 32-bit lane of the weight registers with _m_punpckldq so every lane holds the same weight bit pattern.
Compute the two per-lane deltas with _m_pfsub: a3 - a2 and a4 - a2.
Weight the deltas with _m_pfmul and accumulate with _m_pfadd into the output: a1 = a2 + (a3 - a2) * a5 + (a4 - a2) * a6.
Store the packed result into a1->m64_u64 (two float lanes).
_m_femms() exits MMX/3DNow! state after the packed float math.
